name: SpinCell 5 Plus
summary: 5-part differential hematology analyzer using semiconductor-laser flow cytometry for multi-dimensional cell classification. Runs up to 60 samples per hour from a 50-position autoloader, reports 25 parameters plus reticulocytes from four cyanide-free reagents, and stores more than 200,000 results with scattergrams.

specs.label: WBC & differential
specs.value: WBC, LYM%, MON%, NEU%, EOS%, BASO%, LYM#, MON#, NEU#, EOS#, BAS#

specs.label: RBC
specs.value: RBC, HGB, HCT, MCV, MCH, MCHC, RDW-CV, RDW-SD

specs.label: Platelets
specs.value: PLT, MPV, PDW, PCT, P-LCR, P-LCC

specs.label: Graphics
specs.value: 2 histograms (RBC, PLT), 2 scattergrams (5-part differential, eosinophils/neutrophils), 2 3-D stereograms

specs.label: WBC/DIFF
specs.value: Flow cytometry, semiconductor laser multi-dimensional cell classification

specs.label: Controls
specs.value: CBC-3K normal (3 × 3 mL, 6 × 3 mL) or 3 levels (3 × 3 mL, 6 × 3 mL)

features: Semiconductor laser flow cytometry measures cell size, granularity and complexity
Complete 5-part WBC differential in a single channel
Reticulocyte count with RETIC, RETIC# and IRF
3-D stereograms show the WBC differential from different views
Stores more than 200,000 results with scattergrams
